_comment: Canonical frontmatter schema for plan-artifact files under ${PLANS_DIR}. Enforced via the plan-frontmatter block in pre-write-guard.sh (type arm: the R-65 DENY gate; the remaining arms are the [PLAN FRONTMATTER]/[LIBRARY ...]/[BINDER] advisories). ADDRESS CONVERGENCE: the plans tree is governed by this schema's plan-frontmatter lane at BOTH of its addresses — the physical plans-root path and the vault-view Plans/ symlink spelling. The vault 3-tier schema gate does not apply to the plans tree at either address; the guard's PLANS_ADDR_CONV prelude canonicalizes a vault-view spelling to the physical path (the canonical addressing key), so no path spelling produces a different verdict for the same file.
_derive_note: status: is deliberately ABSENT from every Markdown artifact's required[] and optional[]: the corpus ruled DERIVE — manifest.json :: status is the SOLE status surface, and a plan artifact carries no status: frontmatter. Do not re-add it here. tags: is likewise absent by ruling (plan artifacts are not vault-tagged content).
_parent_plan_rule: parent_plan is conditional_required at path depth >= 3 under the plans root (sub-plan artifacts point at their master); optional at depth 2. Declared here because this field lives in the plans lane, never in the vault frontmatter pillar.

traceability-matrix._note: Rendered read-replica (librarian:matrix-render owns the sentinel region). required[] equals the renderer's preface emit set exactly — the fresh-preface stamp plus the cohort upsert emit these seven keys and nothing else.

manifest._note: manifest.json is JSON, not Markdown. Validated structurally at the top-level JSON keys rather than as YAML frontmatter. The plan-frontmatter advisory skips manifest.json files; existing validate-manifest.sh and /librarian plan-index Read-side parsing cover the JSON-structural checks.
